note: verify.py (online variant) reads the graded episode's record and nothing else: record = its path (the engine restores the declared artifact /var/lib/arb-online root-owned in the separate verifier), record_max_bytes = the largest record it reads. The episode's own configuration (the offline grading run's budgets: simulated-time cap, camera frames, ticks per step, settle time) lives with the graded episode's service, environment/setup/online/graded_config.json
